note: Every typed event a fight puts in GameBattle.events, for views to draw. `fields` must all be there; `optional` may be. Kinds: int, number (int or float), bool, string, ints (an array of ints). A ref is a string: "heir", "ally:N" or "enemy:N". `by` is -1 for the heir, else the companion's index. A side is "player" (the heir), "ally" or "enemy".

act.about: A party member is about to act (GameRound.resolve only); a fallback marker follows the first one of the same member.

cast.about: An ability or spell is used; the blows it causes carry the same `cast` number.

damage.about: A blow lands. side is who was hit: enemy (index), player (the heir) or ally (index of the foe, and ally of the companion).

miss.about: A blow is dodged. side is who dodged.

heal.about: Hit points restored to the heir (side player) or a companion (side ally).

mana.about: Mana gained (positive) or taken by a blow (negative).

hp_cost.about: An ability or feat costs its user hit points.

status.about: A status is applied (applied true, with turns) or ends (applied false; removed says why, and is left out when it was resisted).

skip.about: A status takes a unit's turn.

tick.about: A status's damage or healing at the start of a turn.

advance.about: Foes step up to the front rank.

ko.about: A companion is knocked out for the rest of the fight; foe_scale is the factor the foes' health was rescaled by.

cover.about: A covering member takes a foe's blow meant for another, just before the hit.

defend.about: The heir braces (no `by`, read it as -1) or a companion defends.

coat.about: The heir coats the blade with a toxin.

field.about: An area is fouled (caltrops, a mire).
